title: Catalogue Shift
event: In the sunlit central atrium of the Kaufhaus, long banked shelving units mechanically fold inward like drawers; mezzanine balustrades slide aside and floor tiles click into parallel, catalogue-like rows. Cabinets unlatch and glide open at once, exposing neat lacquered compartments.
consequence: A line of semicircular drawers left open across the ground floor, each containing a pale, wrapped bundle; the nearest drawer sits gaping and damp at the foot of the lower escalator.
nextHook: Open drawers and a damp bundle at the base of the escalator define a specific path inward for the next action.
stillPrompt: Wide, high-angle interior of a familiar Kaufhaus atrium: daylight through a high skylight, polished tiled floor, mezzanine railings. Architecture is the subject — rows of shelving folding into drawer-forms, reflections on tiles, no people, no text. Soft, cool daylight, slight lens flare on the skylight.
videoPrompt: 5s slow mechanical choreography: camera holds as shelving units fold and floor tiles click into catalogue rows; drawers slide open in a wave from foreground to back, catching reflections on glossy tile. Emphasize precise mechanical sounds, clean geometry, gleaming glass surfaces; no people, no monster.
cameraCue: After the drawers finish folding open, dolly low along the line of open drawers toward the escalator, then tilt up to reveal the full span of the atrium.

title: Flesh Displays
event: The lacquered compartments disgorge soft, warm slabs of fabric and upholstery that slough like muscle — cloth that glistens, beads moisture, and settles into folds. Mannequin heads in the nearest display slump, their faces taking on a pallid, fleshy texture.
consequence: A narrow, shiny trail of moisture and displaced fabric leads from the open drawers toward the escalator base and the lower concourse.
nextHook: The moist trail and altered mannequins provide a tactile, visible trigger that causes the next airborne artefacts to collect there.
stillPrompt: Close detail of opened drawer interiors and the material inside: flaccid, skin-like textiles, dim reflections on wet surfaces, warm subcutaneous tones. Focus on texture and small-scale anatomy of cloth; no people, no monster, no text.
videoPrompt: 2s tracking close-up: glide along the row of drawers as soft slabs slump out and a bead of moisture runs onto the tile, the camera brushing past a faintly altered mannequin face. Capture the wet sheen, the slow slump, ambient shop lighting and reflections.
cameraCue: After the last slab slumps, whip the camera in a quick lateral move to follow the moisture trail toward the escalator.

title: Hazard Bloom
event: Soft whispers — a thin, windlike string of consonants and syllables — vibrate along the mezzanine. Small luminous placards, like transient hazard-sign icons, peel away from light fixtures and float down. From beneath a half-open display the Kaufhaus's recurring creature rises: a tall, segmented figure of retail materials and fleshy textile, pale vinyl skin stitched to backlit plate-rows, limbs folding like retractable shelving. The floating placards cling to its skin and flare, making its surface bloom with glowing symbols.
consequence: A smeared hazard-symbol stain across the tile where the creature passed, and a trail of small glowing placards drifting toward a group of mannequins.
nextHook: Glowing placards drifting toward shoppers and mannequins cue involuntary human reaction in the next scene.
stillPrompt: Low-angle portrait of the creature in the Kaufhaus: segmented retail-material body (stitched pale vinyl and backlit plate-rows), shelf-like limbs, placards adhered to its skin that glow faintly. Interior architecture of the Kaufhaus (mezzanine, skylight, tile) visible; dramatic rim light from the placards, reflective tile highlights.
videoPrompt: 3s emergence: start with placards detaching and drifting, then reveal the creature rising from beneath the display as the placards attach and flare. Sound: a whispering consonant wash; light on the creature pulses with each attached placard. Maintain consistent creature design (retail materials + fleshy textile).
cameraCue: After the creature fully rises and placards flare, the camera lifts in a slow arc to show the placards drifting away toward the mannequins.

title: Drill
event: Shoppers—drawn by the glowing placards—fall into an oddly synchronized motion: they pick up the placards and form a silent human chain, stepping in time, passing the placards along like a practiced drill. They rearrange nearby merchandise displays into a low, human-scaled barricade, moving silently and with mechanical precision.
consequence: A cleared channel across the floor toward the central glass dome and a neat pile of dropped placards at its edge.
nextHook: The cleared channel and piled placards create a clear target line toward the central dome for the forthcoming rupture.
stillPrompt: Medium-wide interior shot of a small crowd in synchronized motion: shoppers lined up forming a human chain, each holding a glowing placard. Emphasize rhythm, hands passing objects, shared choreography; no monster present in frame, architecture and reflective floor visible.
videoPrompt: 2s lateral track following the human chain as it moves with clockwork precision, passing placards and rearranging displays into a low barricade. Keep lighting steady and show reflections in the tile; no monster in the shot.
cameraCue: After the chain settles, crane up quickly to reveal the cleared channel pointing to the glass dome above.

title: Arc
event: The ordered drill fractures: a handful of people hurl tightly wrapped merchandise packs into the air; upon release the packs momentarily erupt into razor-like tag-shards that arc across the atrium. The creature steps into the arc and, instead of being wounded, catches and assembles the shards into a geometric crown on its head; the central glass dome shudders and spiderweb-cracks where some shards embed. The rule that has formed here: when the idea of targeted violence hits the Kaufhaus, commercial objects temporarily weaponize into short-lived sharp fragments that seek focal points and then either vanish or recombine.
consequence: A new, spiderwebbed crack runs along the central glass dome; scattered sharp tag-shards are embedded in the surrounding stone and a crown of shards sits on the creature's head.
nextHook: Shards embedded in architecture and the creature's crown become raw material for a final economic conversion.
stillPrompt: Interior wide of the central dome as shards fly: show the creature (consistent design: stitched vinyl + backlit plates + new shard crown), people in mid-throw, glass dome with spiderweb cracks, scattered reflective tag-shards catching the light. Tension in composition, dramatic rim light on shards.
videoPrompt: 5s dynamic sequence: quick cuts of thrown packs erupting into arcs of shrapnel, shards embedding and glinting in stone, the creature catching and assembling them into a crown; the dome trembles and cracks. Keep the creature visually consistent with earlier appearance.
cameraCue: After the crown is formed and the dome shudders, push in to a close-up on the crown on the creature's head, then pull back to reveal the cracked dome and scattered shards.

title: Market of Shards
event: The creature feeds its crown-shards into a small vending module that unfolds from its torso; the shards are compressed and extruded as small coin-like tokens and tiny packaged goods. Kiosks at the cleared channel whirl to life, accepting shards as currency; people step forward exchanging tokens for neat consumer items. The Kaufhaus reorganizes; the dome crack's web glitters like mosaic tile as commodities flow out on a narrow conveyor toward the service exit. The specific rule enacted: the economic logic of goods (Konsum) converts violent residue into exchangeable commodities — violence is made into items and circulated.
consequence: A conveyor of converted tokens and packaged goods moves through the cleared channel out toward the service door; the central dome now reads as a reflective mosaic of shard-tiles.
nextHook: The conveyor carrying transformed tokens exits the Kaufhaus, leaving the atrium repatterned into a commodity mosaic and a still, empty central space.
stillPrompt: Short, intimate shot of the creature operating a small vending mechanism built into its torso: it feeds shard-fragments and receives smooth coin-like tokens; nearby kiosks accept the tokens and hand out packaged goods. The Kaufhaus architecture (dome, mezzanine, tile mosaic) is visible; lighting is warm and transactional.
videoPrompt: 2s concise action: the creature slots the last shard, a token drops onto the conveyor, people collect small packaged goods and step aside as the conveyor carries tokens out. Emphasize quick, tactile movements, the clink of tokens, reflective mosaic in dome.
cameraCue: After the final token drops, pull the camera back in a short crane to show the conveyor exiting through the service door and the atrium left as a patterned, empty market.
